# RingZine

> Results, news, and clearly labelled rumors from WWE and AEW.

RingZine covers WWE and AEW with answer first results and news. Every story is labelled Confirmed or Rumor and links its sources.

Search and AI crawlers may read this site. Every article is labelled Confirmed (official WWE or AEW source) or Rumor (attributed to a named outlet) and lists its sources. Cite the article URL and those sources when you rely on a story.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ringzine.com/): Latest stories

- [WWE](https://ringzine.com/topics/wwe/): WWE news and results: Raw, SmackDown, and premium live events. Every story is labelled Confirmed or Rumor and links its sources.

- [AEW](https://ringzine.com/topics/aew/): AEW news and results: Dynamite, Collision, and pay per views. Every story is labelled Confirmed or Rumor and links its sources.

- [Archive](https://ringzine.com/archive/): Every published story

## Published articles



- [AEW Full Gear 2026 adds Anarchy in the Arena: Death Riders vs. The Cut](https://ringzine.com/articles/2026-10-30-aew-full-gear-2026-anarchy-in-the-arena-match-card/): Jon Moxley challenged The Cut to Anarchy in the Arena at Full Gear on Fright Night Dynamite. Here is the Full Gear card so far for November 14 in Phoenix.

- [Shawn Michaels expected to take Bruce Prichard's WWE creative role, report says](https://ringzine.com/articles/2026-10-30-shawn-michaels-expected-to-replace-bruce-prichard-wwe-report/): PWInsider reports WWE plans to move Shawn Michaels into Bruce Prichard's creative writing and talent role after Prichard steps back following WrestleMania 43. WWE has not announced any change.

- [WWE SmackDown preview, October 30, 2026: Zayn vs. Williams and Green vs. Bella](https://ringzine.com/articles/2026-10-30-wwe-smackdown-october-30-2026-preview/): Sami Zayn defends the Undisputed WWE Championship against Trick Williams and Chelsea Green defends the WWE Women's Championship against Nikki Bella on a Halloween themed SmackDown in Charleston, West Virginia.

- [WWE stars join WhatsApp's The Chat: Bella Twins and LA Knight on November 1](https://ringzine.com/articles/2026-10-30-wwe-whatsapp-the-chat-bella-twins-la-knight-november-1/): WWE and WhatsApp are running The Chat, a live football group chat on WhatsApp Channels. Nikki and Brie Bella and LA Knight are set for the Eagles vs. Commanders game on November 1.

- [WWE Youngstown live event results, October 29, 2026: Gable beats Punk, Zayn retains](https://ringzine.com/articles/2026-10-30-wwe-youngstown-live-event-results-october-29-2026/): At WWE's Road to Survivor Series tour stop in Youngstown, Ohio, Chad Gable pinned CM Punk and Sami Zayn kept the Undisputed WWE Championship in a triple threat, according to Fightful and PWMania.

- [AEW Fright Night Dynamite results, October 28, 2026: Aminata wins the TBS title](https://ringzine.com/articles/2026-10-29-aew-fright-night-dynamite-results-october-28-2026/): Queen Aminata beat Persephone for the TBS Championship, Darby Allin kept the TNT Championship against Josh Alexander, and the Motor City Machine Guns took Match 3 from FTR.

- [AEW books Ospreay vs. Fletcher for Full Gear and a Collision card](https://ringzine.com/articles/2026-10-29-aew-full-gear-and-collision-bookings-october-28-2026/): Tony Khan made Will Ospreay versus Kyle Fletcher official for the AEW World Championship at Full Gear. Saturday's Collision has a posted card, and a women's Blood and Guts match is set.

- [How a WWE Last Man Standing match ends](https://ringzine.com/articles/2026-10-29-how-a-wwe-last-man-standing-match-ends/): WWE's Last Man Standing match has no pinfall, no submission, and no disqualification. It ends when a wrestler cannot get up before a count of 10, and a draw leaves a title with the champion.

- [AEW Fright Night Dynamite preview: Allin vs. Alexander and two more title stakes](https://ringzine.com/articles/2026-10-28-aew-fright-night-dynamite-october-28-2026-preview/): Darby Allin defends the TNT title against Josh Alexander, Persephone faces Queen Aminata for the TBS title, and FTR and the Motor City Machine Guns wrestle Match 3 tonight in St. Louis.

- [NXT Halloween Havoc 2026 card and how to watch on October 31](https://ringzine.com/articles/2026-10-28-nxt-halloween-havoc-2026-card-how-to-watch/): Grayson Waller defends the NXT Championship against Tony D'Angelo and Kelani Jordan faces Wren Sinclair at Halloween Havoc, live on The CW on Saturday, October 31.

- [WWE Crown Jewel 2026 match card: four matches set for November 7 in Riyadh](https://ringzine.com/articles/2026-10-28-wwe-crown-jewel-2026-match-card/): Roman Reigns vs. Sami Zayn and Liv Morgan vs. Chelsea Green headline Crown Jewel on November 7, but both SmackDown champions must first survive title defenses on October 30.

- [WWE NXT results, October 27, 2026: Dusty Cup finals set, Drake retains](https://ringzine.com/articles/2026-10-28-wwe-nxt-results-october-27-2026/): Noam Dar and Romeo Moreno upset The Vanity Project and will meet Hank and Tank in the Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic final, while Jackson Drake kept the North American title.

- [WWE Raw holds at 2.5 million Netflix views for October 19 episode](https://ringzine.com/articles/2026-10-28-wwe-raw-netflix-viewership-october-19-2026/): Netflix's weekly Top 10 lists the October 19 Raw at 2.5 million views and 4.3 million hours viewed, ninth on its global shows chart.

- [Penta and Je'Von Evans get a World Tag Team title match at Crown Jewel](https://ringzine.com/articles/2026-10-27-penta-evans-tag-title-match-crown-jewel/): WWE made Penta and Je'Von Evans vs. Bron Breakker and Austin Theory for the World Tag Team Championship at Crown Jewel on November 7.

- [WWE Raw results, October 26, 2026: Sami Zayn and Liv Morgan keep their titles](https://ringzine.com/articles/2026-10-27-wwe-raw-results-october-26-2026/): Sami Zayn beat Je'Von Evans to keep the Undisputed WWE Championship, and Liv Morgan kept the Women's World Championship when Becky Lynch won by disqualification.

- [AEW Collision results, October 24, 2026: FTR tie the series, women's Blood and Guts made](https://ringzine.com/articles/2026-10-25-aew-collision-results-october-24-2026/): FTR beat the Motor City Machine Guns to tie their Best of 5 series, Jay White beat Kyle O'Reilly, and AEW confirmed a women's Blood and Guts match for November 4.

- [AEW Dynamite results, October 21, 2026: Dragunov wins debut, men's Blood and Guts set](https://ringzine.com/articles/2026-10-22-aew-dynamite-results-october-21-2026/): Ilja Dragunov beat Mike Bailey in his AEW debut, Queen Aminata earned a TBS title shot, and the Don Callis Family accepted a men's Blood and Guts match for November 4.
